new_today_news.headline: Waste Hauler Insurance Rates Remain Stable as New Entrants Exert Downward Pressure
new_today_news.summary: Environmental insurance market remains stable with broad carrier competition. For primary casualty lines, pricing generally ranges from flat to 10% increases depending on operational nature, size, and location. Driver shortage pressures carriers to make exceptions on driver hiring requirements.

new_today_news.headline: EPA Approves Oversight for San Jacinto Waste Pit Superfund Site
new_today_news.summary: The EPA announced that responsible parties for the San Jacinto Waste Pits Superfund site have selected supervisors and coordinators for the remediation project. The plan involves excavating nearly 230,000 cubic yards of contaminated material from the 15-acre northern impoundment.
